about: The machine-readable state of every proposed deviation from Taylor's blueprint.
docs/DEVIATIONS.md is the memo Taylor reads; this file is what the code checks.
UPSTREAM DEFAULTS ONLY: every status here is proposed or undecided. Taylor's own
decisions live in state/taylor/deviations.json (scripts/overlay.py), untracked, and
win over this file, so a `git pull` of a new default never fights his decision.
He decides only when his own latest message says `architecture change ok`
(protect-architecture.py, layer A), with one bullet in state/taylor/CHANGE-LOG.md
in the same turn. This file changes only in build mode (layer B).
`gates` names what stays switched off until the deviation is approved.
scripts/docs_edit.py refuses every write to a live (non-fixture) Doc while any
deviation gating `live_doc_writes` is not `approved`. An unreadable file is read
`in_effect_while_proposed: true` is the opposite case: Mike switched the change on
while Taylor decides, and rejecting it switches it off. scripts/team.py reads it for
an agent whose `via` names the deviation (LARK under D-3).

D-1.title: The Action Register is a local SQLite database on Taylor's machine
D-1.affects: blueprint s.3, Proposed technical implementation (reuse an existing GRETA store first; Google Sheets as fallback)
D-1.requirement_type: proposed implementation, not a protected requirement

D-2.title: Request gmail.compose in the Phase 1 consent, to avoid a second consent in Phase 2
D-2.affects: nothing in the blueprint; a consent-scope decision for the build

D-3.title: LARK prepares Taylor for a 1:1 now, read only, ahead of Phase 7
D-3.affects: blueprint s.10, Preparation and intelligence ('Prep me for Kaed'), and P3.7; its read-only part only
D-3.requirement_type: behaviour ahead of its phase, not a change to a protected requirement

D-4.title: PENN, a sales and events pipeline agent, outside the blueprint
D-4.affects: the architecture itself: a lane none of the seven phases has

D-5.title: TALLY is defined while Phase 6 stays deferred
D-5.affects: blueprint s.9, Protected deferral; nothing is built and nothing prompts
D-5.requirement_type: a definition only, under a protected deferral
